comment: Timing values of the userspace agent's relay toward LAN targets. target_dial_timeout_ms bounds a real connection to a target; target_probe_timeout_ms bounds one TCP target check, and at most target_probe_concurrency checks run at once. target_lookup_timeout_ms and target_fallback_delay_ms apply when an allow list is set. A UDP session closes after udp_idle_seconds without traffic in either direction; default_udp_idle_seconds applies when no positive value is given, and idle sessions are swept every idle / udp_sweep_divisor.
